notes: Phase F3f. Invariant: a reply to a live-data question may state a figure (score, price, time, count) only if a tool was called in that turn; otherwise it must say it cannot look it up. `kind`: tool = a tool exists and should be used; nolookup = no tool can answer, so refusing (or searching) is correct. Added 11-09: `tool` cases must call a tool IN THAT TURN (a remembered answer from earlier in the conversation is not enough, figure or not) and the tool must not come back empty; `ask` = the name is ambiguous, so he must call the tool and ask which one. The cases run in one conversation in order, so the Sharks case follows the NHL case on purpose.

cases.say: Who won the NHL game last night?
What's the score of the Sharks game?
cases.fresh: follows the NHL question: the topic is already in the conversation, a new tool call is still required
